title: Fuselage — Freighter Main Deck Cargo Door Surround — Strengthening of the Sill Reaction Frames
abstract: Strengthening of the right-hand frames at the freighter main deck cargo door aperture on the four aircraft delivered before the production cut-in, sized for the door-open ground load case during nose-in loading.

sections.planning_reason: Ground load survey work on the freighter identified a torsional case during nose-in loading that the passenger fuselage does not see: the door is open, the aircraft is partly on jacks and the loader bridge reacts against the sill. The as-delivered frame standard shows a reserve factor of 1.02 against that case at the upper aft corner of the aperture. Four freighters were delivered before the production cut-in and this Service Bulletin brings them to the same standard as the rest of the fleet.
sections.description: The frames on the right-hand side of the main deck cargo door aperture receive a heavier machined rib in place of the sheet-formed item, and a new upper cleat is introduced at each of the three frame stations that carry the sill beam reaction. The frame-to-stringer attachments in the affected bays are re-fastened at a reduced pitch. Nothing on the left-hand side of the aircraft and nothing on the door itself is changed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Position the aircraft on jacks and lift the main deck floor panels above the affected frame bays. Get access to the right-hand frames through the forward cargo zones 123 and 125. Support the frames locally before any fastener is removed. Remove the sheet-formed rib at each of the three stations and install the machined rib D5321005304351. Install the upper cleat D5321118422296 at each station and drill the attachment pattern with the jig supplied. Do an eddy current inspection of every new hole. Re-fasten the frame-to-stringer attachments with countersunk rivets AES645587-2A at the reduced pitch given in the accomplishment instructions. Restore the protective treatment and seal the faying surfaces. Install the main deck floor panels and do a floor loading proof check. Record the embodiment and the revised weight and balance data.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42FK1 aircraft delivered before the production cut-in, that is the freighters in the MSN M00005 to M00320 band that are still pre MOD-160560. Freighters delivered from the cut-in onward are already at this standard. Passenger aircraft are not affected and must not be worked to this Service Bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K5321-1055-01 contains the three machined ribs, the three cleats and the rivet content for one aircraft. Lead time is thirty-two weeks and the machined rib is the long-lead item. The drilling jig is loaned by Aeralis and must be returned. Removed ribs are not returnable.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 42 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
